scientific_integrity: Closed forms are proved by parity-projected transfer matrices and exact characteristic polynomials. A standalone direct-payoff finite enumeration cross-checks small rings; finite enumeration is not the proof of the all-size formulas. The classical ring PNE-existence test is correctly attributed as previous work.
scientific_limitations: Exact first and second moments for fair iid binary agent types on fixed simple cycles only; does not address biased types, arbitrary networks, quenched counts or equilibrium-selection dynamics. The 2016 statistical-mechanics full text was unavailable for checking; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Exact equilibrium-count moments on random conformist–rebel rings
